records.label: Registered Meta API Description
records.notes: API/schema description for registered metadata. This is distinct from editor-facing field.instructions/help text.

records.label: Registered Meta Authorization Provider
records.notes: Provider-safe representation of register_meta() auth_callback for add/edit/delete metadata capability checks; arbitrary executable callback text is not configuration.

records.label: Protected Meta Key Policy
records.notes: WordPress treats underscore-prefixed keys as protected by default, filterable by is_protected_meta; register_meta() also uses this policy as the default authorization fallback.

records.label: Subtype Registration Override Precedence
records.notes: Object-type-wide registration can be partly overridden by a more specific registration of the same key for an object subtype.

records.label: Default Value Schema Validation
records.notes: WordPress validates a registered default against the effective metadata/REST schema before accepting registration.

records.label: Metadata Revisions Require Post Object Type
records.notes: revisions_enabled is rejected unless the metadata object type is post.

records.label: Metadata Revisions Require Revision-capable Post Subtype
records.notes: When an object_subtype is supplied, WordPress requires that post type to support revisions before metadata revisions can be enabled.

records.label: Registered Meta Arguments Provider
records.notes: Provider-safe extension point for the register_meta_args filter; WPE does not store arbitrary executable filter code in normal configuration.

records.label: Block Binding Source Name
records.notes: Canonical namespaced source identity. WordPress requires lowercase namespace/slug syntax; client and server registration must use the same identity when both exist.

records.label: Block Binding Source Label
records.notes: Human-readable source label used by the Block Bindings source contract.

records.label: Editor Block Binding Label Override
records.notes: When the editor registers a label for the same source, WordPress uses the editor-side label instead of the server label.

records.label: Block Binding Source Value Filter Provider
records.notes: Provider-safe representation of the native block_bindings_source_value filter that can modify a resolved source value after its source callback.

records.label: Block Binding Editor Default Read-only Policy
records.notes: Editor-bound values are not editable by default when canUserEditValue is absent or does not authorize editing; explicit edit authorization remains provider-backed.

coverage.notes: Native audit delta only: gaps proven by the WordPress 7.1-era Metadata and Block Bindings public contracts. Runtime registry helpers and out-of-surface block infrastructure are classified in the native audit disposition matrix rather than inflated into user-facing Bank options.
